title: turfc --unsafe-report, where a project's unsafe code is
description: LB-2, driver interface 1.12. With --package-graph: every package of the graph and the standard library. With files instead: those files. Format 1: keys are only added, never changed or removed. Every .tr file under a package's src/ is counted, imported or not. Native sources are not here: they are LB-1's [native] table, which turf.toml does not have yet.

packages.description: With --package-graph: one entry per package of the graph, keyed by its name.

stdlib.description: With --package-graph: lib/std of the compiler's install root. allow_unsafe is always true.

files.description: Without --package-graph: each file named on the command line, in order, with its path as given.

allow_unsafe.description: Whether the package's `unsafe module;` is honored: the graph's allow_unsafe (the root's [unsafe] allow decides it for a dependency).

unsafe_modules.description: Files whose first statement is `unsafe module;`.

unsafe_blocks.description: `unsafe { }` blocks, as statements, expressions or around top-level declarations.

extern_fns.description: `extern fn` declarations, at the top level or inside a function.

link_libraries.description: The libraries named by `extern from "lib"`, sorted, each once.

files.description: The files with something to report (any count above, or an error), by path.

path.description: Relative to the package's src/ (or lib/std), with '/'.

error.description: Present when the file does not lex: "line N: message". The counts are those of the tokens before it.
